**Chinese name:** 珠海市全志科技股份有限公司 (Zhūhǎi Shì Quánzhì Kējì Gǔfèn Yǒuxiàn Gōngsī)

::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Founded 2007 in Zhuhai, Guangdong; alongside Rockchip, one of the two dominant Chinese SoC vendors in the budget tablet and embedded/IoT hardware segment.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Application processor SoCs for tablets, streaming devices, and consumer IoT hardware.
